feeds.title: Shuttlecock Music Magazine
feeds.description: Launched in 2015, Shuttlecock Music Magazine is dedicated to featuring in-depth coverage of new and exciting music emerging from Kansas City and the surrounding areas. The website features concert coverage, interviews, podcasts, streams of new releases, and video content.

feeds.title: 90.9 The Bridge
feeds.description: Latest music news, live shows, reviews, and playlist from 90.9 The Bridge.90.9 the Bridge is Kansas City's listener-supported, non-commercial NPR music radio station.

feeds.title: Plastic Sax
feeds.description: Plastic Sax is the most reliable source for jazz news and reviews in Kansas City. Telling the truth about Kansas City's jazz scene since 2007.

feeds.title: Riverfront Times » Music Blog
feeds.description: Riverfront Times music blog covers articles on local music, concerts, music events, ticket alerts, music venues, music festivals, and music series news.Riverfront Times is St. Louis' only alternative newspaper, covering the news, entertainment, food & events.

feeds.title: The Pitch » Music
feeds.description: The Pitch is Kansas City's source for progressive, independent, street-level coverage of news, arts, music, and culture. Browse the Music blog to learn about Kansas City's music scene - rock, hip-hop, rap, indie, punk, and country.

feeds.title: Kansas City Public Radio 89.3 » Music
feeds.description: KCPR 89.3 covers articles on Kansas city local music, classical music, arts and life, artists news, and Orchestra news. Kansas City Public Radio 89.3 NPR in Kansas City covers local news, entertainment, and podcasts.

feeds.title: Kansas City Symphony
feeds.description: Keep up with everything going on at the Kansas City Symphony. News and updates about our upcoming performances.The Kansas City Symphony offers great performances for greater audiences to transform hearts, minds, and communities through the power of symphonic music.

feeds.title: High Dive Records
feeds.description: Find the latest music news, music records, bands, music releases, and shows by High Dive Records.High Dive Records is a record label in Kansas City.

feeds.title: The Record Machine
feeds.description: Receive news and updates from The Record Machine.The Record Machine is a homegrown, pioneering independent record label based in Kansas City, MO. We aim to work with a diverse group of musicians who are hardworking, dedicated, and stand out on their own accord.

feeds.title: Kansas City Jazz Ambassadors Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news, festival, events, and announcements by the Kansas City Jazz Ambassadors.KCJA is Kansas City's longest running non-profit organization dedicated to the preservation of Kansas City Jazz.

feeds.title: Heartland Men's Chorus Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news, events and announcements by the Heartland Men's Chorus.Heartland Men's Chorus is Kansas City's 125-voice gay men's chorus group singing out in Kansas City since 1986.

feeds.title: Base Academy of Music Blog
feeds.description: Base Academy of Music is non-profit music organization that makes starting to learn a musical instrument accessible and affordable for urban youth.

feeds.title: Odyssey Chamber Music Series Blog
feeds.description: Latest news, announcements, programs, and artist news on Odyssey Chamber Music Series.The Odyssey Chamber Music Series is a non-profit organization dedicated to presenting and promoting classical music of smaller ensembles with a modern flair.

feeds.title: Soundstructure Studios Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news and updates from the Soundstructure Studios.Soundstructure Rehearsal Studios is the place where musicians come to hone their artistic talents and craft.

feeds.title: Nottelmann Music Company Blog
feeds.description: The Nottelmann Blog is a music resource exclusively for music educators. Nottelmann Music Company has been providing quality products with exceptional customer service to the St. Louis region since 1953.
